Enable or disable fallback from remote to local authentication. When enabled and a remote auth source is configured, if the remote auth server is unavailable, authentication will fallback to local authentication. The default value is false.
type
string
optional
read/write
Specifies the default user authorization source. The default value is local. When user accounts that access the system reside on a remote server, the value of source type is the type of server that you are using for authentication, for example, ldap.
